p.s: Dear Mr Manager
With reference to the show last week.
I am writing to complain about the show, which was very disappointed.
In the advertisement, it state that the actor for this show is Danny Brook and TINA TRUELOVE.
As a result I asked my acquintance to come with me to the show.
As soon as the show started.
I realised that the actor wasn't DANNY.
I was very disappointed.
In addition the concert didn't start on time.
It was quarter of an hour late.
If I knew that the show was going to be late, I would ask my mom to come with me, because her working hour ended at eight o'clock.
The restaurant was closed after the show ended.
On the other hand there were no discounts available, as a result I had to paid extra money for the tickets.
In conclusion it wasn't a perfect evening, I didn't enjoy it at all due to the failure advertisement.
I would like to ask for my money back.
Your sincerely
Thatt Chitchee
